ei.title: Powerful Effects of Peers on Children
ei.subject: 6월_2020 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Powerful Effects of Peers on Children

fullPassage: Positively or negatively, our parents and families are powerful influences on us. But even stronger, especially when we're young, are our friends. We often choose friends as a way of expanding our sense of identity beyond our families. As a result, the pressure to conform to the standards and expectations of friends and other social groups is likely to be intense. Judith Rich Harris, who is a developmental psychologist, argues that three main forces shape our development: personal temperament, our parents, and our peers. The influence of peers, she argues, is much stronger than that of parents. "The world that children share with their peers," she says, "is what shapes their behavior and modifies the characteristics they were born with, and hence determines the sort of people they will be when they grow up."

questions.passage: Positively or negatively, our parents and families are (A)[powerful / trivial] influences on us. But even stronger, especially when we're young, are our friends. As a result, the pressure to conform to the standards and expectations of friends and other social groups is likely to be (C)[intense / mild]. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) powerful=강력한, (B) expanding=확장하는, (C) intense=강렬한
det.analysis:
✅ ① powerful(강력한) — expanding(확장하는) — intense(강렬한): 원문과 일치하는 올바른 조합 ←정답
❌ ② trivial(사소한) — expanding(확장하는) — intense(강렬한): trivial은 '사소한'이라는 뜻으로 powerful(강력한)의 반의어
❌ ③ powerful(강력한) — limiting(제한하는) — intense(강렬한): limiting은 '제한하는'이라는 뜻으로 expanding(확장하는)의 반의어
❌ ④ powerful(강력한) — expanding(확장하는) — mild(가벼운): mild는 '가벼운'이라는 뜻으로 intense(강렬한)의 반의어
det.tip: powerful influences / expanding our sense / pressure is intense

det.analysis: ✅ 정답: expectations (동사 expect → 명사 expectation + 복수 -s)
det.tip: standards and expectations — 병렬 구조로 복수 명사

questions.passage: Positively or negatively, our parents and families are powerful influences on us. But even stronger, especially when we're young, are our friends. We often choose friends as a way of expanding our __________ beyond our families. As a result, the pressure to conform to the standards and expectations of friends and other social groups is likely to be intense. Judith Rich Harris, who is a developmental psychologist, argues that three main forces shape our development: personal temperament, our parents, and our peers. The influence of peers, she argues, is much stronger than that of parents. "The world that children share with their peers," she says, "is what shapes their behavior and modifies the characteristics they were born with, and hence determines the sort of people they will be when they grow up."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가족 너머로 정체성의 감각(sense of identity)을 확장하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① sense of humor — 유머 감각은 맥락과 무관
✅ ② sense of identity — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ source of income — 수입원은 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ standard of living — 생활 수준은 정체성 확장 맥락과 무관
det.tip: expanding our sense of identity beyond our families

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성장하면 어떤 종류의 사람(the sort of people they will be)이 될지 결정한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the number of friends they make — 사귀는 친구 수는 determines의 목적어로 부적절
✅ ② the sort of people they will be — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ the amount of time they spend — 쓰는 시간의 양은 발달 맥락과 불일치
❌ ④ the level of stress they face — 직면하는 스트레스 수준은 맥락과 무관
det.tip: determines the sort of people they will be when they grow up
